title: Coach Personalization Demo — Synthetic Data Schema
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema + data dictionary derived from sample_data.xlsx. Four event/profile tables across two domains: Optimizely event-export (conversions, decisions) and ODP/Zaius profiles (ODP Events, ODP Customers). Each property carries x-dict (data dictionary) and x-generator (synthetic-data hints). Population rates reflect the source sample; preserve them for realism.

x-conventions.country_code: ODP Events uses ISO-3 lowercase (usa); ODP Customers uses full name (France) — preserve per table
x-conventions.ip_address: Optimizely tables anonymize (last octet .0); ODP Events stores full IP — preserve per table
x-conventions.nested_json: attributes/layer_states/experiments use Optimizely BQ wrapper; keep experiment_id→variation_id internally consistent
x-conventions.sparsity: Low population on PII/enrichment is signal (anonymous-first, few authenticate) — do not over-fill

odp_events.x-note: Wide superset schema; ~63% of columns empty in sample. Generate populated columns; treat empty as schema-present null.
